sources.name: arXiv

coverage.geography: Global submissions with strongest coverage in physics, mathematics, computer science, and adjacent fields.

canonicalFor: arXiv submission version and withdrawal metadata

access.rateLimit: Legacy API, RSS, and OAI clients should make no more than one request every three seconds.

freshness.upstreamCadence: The bounded legacy API exposes announced submissions and is queried by reviewed terms and submitted date; OAI remains the authoritative bulk metadata path but its provider-sized pages exceed this MVP's limits.
freshness.expectedLag: Best-effort new-submission discovery only. Offset cursors over a changing result set are not a complete or stable update/deletion feed; consumers must overlap and restart rather than claim lossless sync.

rights.metadataClaim: Descriptive API metadata is offered as CC0; item content remains under its submitted licence or copyright.
rights.redistribution: This module republishes normalized metadata and links only; it does not copy article content. Product displays should include: Thank you to arXiv for use of its open access interoperability.

risks: Preprints are not peer reviewed.
The bounded live adapter is best-effort submission discovery and may miss later versions or withdrawals.
Most full text cannot be redistributed without checking the item licence.

sources.name: bioRxiv and medRxiv

coverage.geography: Global submissions in biology, health sciences, and medicine.

access.rateLimit: Public API is paged in groups of 100; clients should remain bounded and courteous.

freshness.upstreamCadence: Date-range and recent-item API views expose posted records and versions.
freshness.expectedLag: Published-journal links can appear after publication and should be treated as later observations.

rights.metadataClaim: Metadata API access is public; each manuscript has an author-selected content licence.
rights.redistribution: Metadata may be indexed with attribution; rehosting full text is outside this module and requires item-specific review.

risks: Screening is not peer review.
Content licences vary by item.
Published-article relations may lag or remain absent.

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov

coverage.geography: International study registrations submitted to the United States registry.

canonicalFor: submitted ClinicalTrials.gov registration and results metadata

access.rateLimit: Public API v2; this module caps one explicit poll at three pages and 300 metadata records.

freshness.upstreamCadence: Data generally refreshes Monday through Friday around 09:00 US Eastern time.
freshness.expectedLag: Registry processing and sponsor updates can lag real-world study events.

rights.metadataClaim: Registry data is publicly available with required attribution/currentness practices and third-party caveats.
rights.redistribution: Derived metadata must identify ClinicalTrials.gov, processing date, and modifications; third-party material may have separate rights.

risks: Live polling is disabled in 0.1 until the zone-less source processing timestamp and modification disclosure are modeled without inventing UTC.
Sponsor or investigator submission is not a quality endorsement.
A registration is not a positive result.
Duplicate registrations across registries need explicit identifier links.

sources.name: Crossref

access.rateLimit: The current Crossref polite list pool reports three requests per second, aggregated by identified email; follow returned headers because limits can change.

freshness.upstreamCadence: REST index-date filters support fine-grained incremental polling; the public full file is annual and paid snapshots are monthly.
freshness.expectedLag: Deposits and later corrections arrive on publisher schedules; polling must overlap and deduplicate.

rights.metadataClaim: Most bibliographic fields are factual and openly retrievable; abstracts and some deposited fields may remain copyrighted.
rights.redistribution: Republish normalized facts with attribution and retain field provenance; do not assume abstracts are reusable.

risks: Metadata completeness depends on member deposits.
Abstract, reference, affiliation, funding, and relation coverage is uneven.
There is no webhook; incremental clients need overlap and replay.

sources.name: Crossref updates and Retraction Watch

coverage.geography: Global Crossref update relations plus Retraction Watch records distributed through Crossref.

canonicalFor: Retraction Watch status record as distributed by Crossref

access.rateLimit: The current Crossref polite list pool reports three requests per second, aggregated by identified email; follow returned headers because limits can change.

freshness.upstreamCadence: Retraction Watch data is updated each working day; publisher-deposited Crossmark updates arrive on publisher schedules.
freshness.expectedLag: Notices can lag the underlying event and coverage is not complete.

rights.metadataClaim: The Retraction Watch database distributed by Crossref is CC0; Crossref requests citation when it is used in published work.
rights.redistribution: Freely reusable as CC0; preserve notice type, date, target, source, record ID, and requested citation. Linked content rights remain separate.

risks: Correction and retraction coverage remains incomplete.
The same assertion may appear from publisher and retraction-watch sources and must not be silently collapsed.
Status must be modeled as sourced, dated evidence rather than a permanent boolean verdict.

sources.name: DataCite

access.rateLimit: Anonymous REST clients receive 500 requests per five minutes; identified and authenticated tiers are higher.

freshness.upstreamCadence: REST and OAI-PMH expose current metadata; the public full dump is annual and member snapshots are monthly. This MVP's bounded live query selects records by created time only.
freshness.expectedLag: Created-record discovery can miss later metadata updates; updates depend on repository deposits and their metadata practices.

rights.metadataClaim: DataCite DOI metadata is released under CC0.
rights.redistribution: Metadata can be redistributed; each linked dataset, software object, or document retains its own rights.

risks: Depositor metadata quality and resource types vary.
Duplicate and version relations require explicit handling.
Metadata CC0 does not grant rights to the identified object.

sources.name: Europe PMC

coverage.geography: Global life-science literature, preprints, grants, citations, data links, and text-mined annotations.

canonicalFor: Europe PMC record identifier and aggregation state

access.rateLimit: Public REST is cursor-paged; this module caps explicit polls below the service page maximum.

freshness.upstreamCadence: Search APIs expose current indexed records; selected metadata and open-content bulk files update weekly.
freshness.expectedLag: Aggregation, citation, text-mining, and publication-link updates can trail primary registries.

rights.metadataClaim: EMBL-EBI imposes no additional restriction on supplied data beyond rights held by original data owners; public queryability is not itself a reuse grant.
rights.redistribution: Attribute Europe PMC and EMBL-EBI, comply with original-owner rights, and accept responsibility for third-party permissions. This module republishes selected normalized metadata only and no full text.

risks: Coverage is concentrated in life sciences.
Aggregation and derived citation/entity links can lag.
Full-text rights differ by record.

sources.name: OpenAlex

coverage.geography: Broad global graph spanning works, authors, institutions, sources, topics, publishers, and funders.

canonicalFor: OpenAlex entity identifier and graph assertions

access.rateLimit: Casual basic queries may be keyless; a free key raises the daily budget. List calls have a hard per_page maximum of 100 and cursor paging uses meta.next_cursor.

freshness.upstreamCadence: The public API supports bounded discovery queries. True from_updated_date/from_created_date synchronization filters and daily changefiles require paid access.
freshness.expectedLag: The MVP uses free from_publication_date discovery, not paid update synchronization; later metadata changes can therefore be missed unless another source reports them.

rights.metadataClaim: OpenAlex metadata is released under CC0.
rights.redistribution: Graph metadata can be redistributed; linked abstracts and content may carry upstream rights and are not ingested here.

risks: Author, topic, citation, and deduplication assertions are algorithmic rather than canonical.
Free publication-date polling is discovery, not a complete update feed.
Do not send a free key with paid-only synchronization filters or describe it as a paid entitlement.

sources.name: PubMed and PubMed Central

coverage.geography: Global biomedical and life-science citations; PMC adds an archive of participating full-text works.

access.rateLimit: E-utilities permits about three requests per second without a key and ten with a key; bulk daily update files are preferred for complete deltas.

freshness.upstreamCadence: PubMed publishes an annual XML baseline and daily new, revised, and deleted citation files.
freshness.expectedLag: Publisher deposits, MeSH indexing, and linked corrections may arrive after first citation publication.

rights.metadataClaim: NLM database records are downloadable under NLM terms; source-supplied material can retain separate rights.
rights.redistribution: Attribute NLM, preserve update dates, and label stale or modified data; PMC full text is outside this MVP.

risks: Coverage is biomedical rather than all-discipline.
Indexing and publisher corrections can lag.
Full-text reuse rights are separate from citation metadata.
